verdict.rationale: Retell's first-party custom-telephony guide covers integrating your own provider via elastic SIP trunking and importing numbers from Twilio, Telnyx and Vonage. It describes the flow: set up a SIP trunk, point your number at it, then import it. Imported numbers also work with agent tools such as Send SMS, and custom SIP headers can be sent on end-call. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SIP/BYO-carrier setup, and explicit PBX-specific configuration detail.
